overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Materials 2x Daily ETF (XLBX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in materials equity. The fund seeks daily investment results corresponding to 2x the daily performance of the State Street Materials Select Sector SPDR Fund. The fund provides leveraged exposure to U.S XLBX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
